messages:
Nima: heads-up, onboarding palomino-12b (v1-int4) on pool-9. seeing intermittent OOMs around long generations and a small rouge-like drop on summarization (~1.9 pts). root: `kv_cache_alloc failed`
Faye: what's the runtime config? prefetch / batch_window / max_new_tokens / slot_reserve?
Nima: defaults: prefetch=true, batch_window=40ms, microbatch=4, slot_reserve=0.05, max_new_tokens=320. repro prompt -> ~1k tokens generated; failures ~650-780 tokens.
Omar: slot fragmentation looks like the culprit in similar cases. do we have slot_frag and allocator logs? if slot_frag > 0.2 it's a red flag.
Nima: pasted node excerpt:
```
ERROR OOM kv_alloc
used=12.1GB free=0.45GB slot_frag=0.26
backtrace: ...
```
ci-bot: Canary build queued: palomino-12b-int4 -> pool-9 (job 4890012346)
Faye: quick experiments to try (cheap): 1) disable prefetch + cap `max_new_tokens=160`; 2) keep prefetch but enable `compact_on_evict=true` and raise `slot_compactor_threshold=0.14`; 3) reduce `max_parallel_requests` to 2. which first?
Nima: going with #1 first. launching: `curl -X POST https://canary/api/serve -d '{"model":"palomino-12b-int4","opts":{"prefetch":false,"max_new_tokens":160}}'` (job 4890012347)
Omar: also start a targeted A/B on 300 summarization prompts comparing v1-int4 -> v1-int8 to see if quantization is the quality source. if int8 matches float perf, then int4 calibration needed for attention/kv scales.
Nima: update — after disabling prefetch + max_new_tokens=160: ran ~1800 calls, zero OOMs. p50 latency +12ms, cost +6%. starting int8 AB now (job 4890012358).
Faye: good. create an automated alert: rollback if OOM_rate > 0.05% or ROUGE-like drops > 1.5 pts on the summarization eval. also collect `nvidia-smi` + allocator traces on OOM.
Omar: medium-term plan: enable `compact_on_evict` + `slot_compactor_threshold=0.15`, test on canary for 24h. add diagnostics to track slot_frag over time (graph per GPU).
Nima: agreed. if the int8 AB shows no quality regression, we can experiment with hybrid fallback: keep int4 weights but use int8 for attention & kv; or run per-channel scale calibration for those layers.
Faye: if we roll out conservative defaults, document them: max_new_tokens=160, prefetch=false, max_parallel_requests=2 for palomino-12b-int4 initial 48h. include rollback conditions in the rollout doc.
Nima: will update the canary config and add the eval harness. posting AB results tomorrow. thanks :thumbsup:
